observations.scene: Kneeling in a research station, comparing habitat maps on the floor with an observation photograph held in her right hand.
observations.outfit: Pink cropped technical vest, pale fitted tank, mini shorts and ankle boots; waist and thighs exposed.
observations.pose: Both knees on the floor with shins folded behind; one hand points to a map while the other holds a landscape photograph.
observations.framing: Head, hands, knees and boots readable; forward leaning view rather than extreme crouching camera.
observations.expression: Wide attentive eyes, slightly raised brow and parted lips.
observations.hands: Pointing hand: extended index, thumb and three naturally curled fingers. Photograph hand: four fingers around edge, thumb partly obscured. Two arms continuous from shoulders.
observations.diversity: Low research task and vest/shorts silhouette differ from yacht sunbathing, Uxie mirror/car scenes and the last three comparison characters.
